title.zh: 经历控制与保留使用的经验范围
title.en: Empirical scope of encounter control and retained use

statement.zh: 公开CuriGaze正式纳入75人、451试次的复算中，主动条件相对配对条件的目标注视变化差为−1.34个百分点，常规95% Welch区间为[−10.38,+7.69]。它约束选择自动产生学习优势的经验对应。
statement.en: Reanalysis of the public CuriGaze inclusion sample, 75 participants and 451 trials, gives Curiosity−Yoked target-looking change of −1.34 percentage points, conventional 95% Welch interval [−10.38,+7.69]. This constrains an automatic selection-to-learning-advantage correspondence.

hypotheses.zh: 按作者清理名单与试次表共同字段纳入；先在参与者内平均。77人的较早导出另存敏感性，不择行追随期望结论。
hypotheses.en: Use the authors’ cleaned inclusion list joined to trial records, averaging within participants first. Retain the earlier 77-person export as sensitivity; do not select rows to fit a desired finding.

hypotheses.zh: 常规t/Welch区间以参与者独立为条件；配对身份未获得，顺序采样覆盖率未证明，参与者随机分配未确立。
hypotheses.en: Conventional t/Welch intervals condition on participant independence. Pair identities are unavailable, sequential-design coverage is unproved, and randomized participant allocation is not established.

hypotheses.zh: 论文已知后的探索性二次分析；目标注视变化不是学习词数比例，也不独自识别概念理解、控制识别或保留机制。
hypotheses.en: Exploratory secondary analysis after the paper was known. Change in target looking is not proportion of words learned and does not alone identify comprehension, recognized control or a retention mechanism.

correspondence.zh: 控制、有效取得、保留和证据接纳是同一经历史中的不同作用关系。显示内容相同未证明保留输入相同；另一指点研究的积极结果不把跨研究差异识别为单一社会因果。
correspondence.en: Control, effective access, retention and evidence admission are distinct roles within one history. Matched displays do not establish equal retained inputs; a positive pointing comparison does not identify a single social cause across different studies.

detail.zh: 复用已完成的选择与解释接口；后续测量约束其心理对应，不声称把数据形式转换为Lean历史。
detail.en: Reuse the completed selection/interpretation interface; later measurement constrains psychological correspondence without a formal conversion of data to Lean histories.

detail.zh: 从已有自动注视覆盖边界转向后续学习测量；不同人群与任务不拼接为同一观察史。
detail.en: Moves from the existing automatic gaze-coverage boundary to a later-learning measure; different populations/tasks are not joined into one observed history.

detail.zh: 区间容许正负差异，不足以认定等效；两人的名单遗漏原因与配对关系不明。原始轨迹未复算，论文表中SD差异和单值多重校正问题明示。
detail.en: Intervals admit positive and negative differences and cannot establish equivalence. Two log-omission reasons and pair mappings are unknown. Raw trajectories are not reprocessed; table-SD discrepancies and singleton multiple-adjustment code are disclosed.

does_not_show.zh: 未建立保留优势或等效。
does_not_show.en: It establishes neither a retention advantage nor equivalence.

does_not_show.zh: 不识别唯一心理机制或社会原因。
does_not_show.en: It does not identify a unique psychological mechanism or social cause.

does_not_show.zh: 不识别长期记忆、意识或演化起源。
does_not_show.en: It does not identify long-term memory, consciousness or evolutionary origin.

progress.zh: 后续使用：从原始汇总与纳入名单复算后续目标注视，接入既有研究；选择由此受到结果层约束，下一目标为经验可靠性／协调变化→证据使用改变→后来的绑定、迁移与纠正。
progress.en: Later use: target looking reconstructed from original summaries and the inclusion log constrains selection at outcome level; next: experienced reliability/coordination changes → changed evidence use → later binding, transfer and correction.

progress.zh: 来源重释：取得的来源关系以另一路径生成旧命名记录的绑定候选；历史适用范围的反例具体化后续连接。
progress.en: Source reinterpretation: acquired source relations generate binding alternatives for old naming records through an additional route; a historical-applicability counterexample sharpens the next connection.

progress.zh: 历史适用范围：组合与反审把接续问题转向来源—时序保持及持续性假设的经验识别。
progress.en: Historical applicability: its composition and counterreview turn the continuation toward empirical identification of source–time retention and persistence assumptions.

progress.zh: 五篇原典：区分取得、保持与使用；原典已约束自动迁移，但未识别唯一机制或演化史。
progress.en: Five primary sources: formation, retention and use are distinguished; primary evidence constrains automatic transfer without identifying a unique mechanism or evolutionary history.

validation_scope.zh: 八个原始小文件与OSF哈希匹配；清理名单来自已验证压缩包。独立CSV/Decimal运算重构比例、参与者均值、方差、ANOVA及Welch算术，分布函数共用SciPy。作者实质反审完成，无独立agent验收或新Lean证明。
validation_scope.en: Eight small originals match OSF hashes; the cleaned log comes from a verified archive. Separate CSV/Decimal calculations reconstruct proportions, participant means, variances, ANOVA and Welch arithmetic, sharing SciPy distribution functions. Substantive author counterreview completed; no independent-agent acceptance or new Lean proof.

next_delta.zh: 在保留的既有条件连接之上，于匹配发育程序中识别已取得访问及所保留来源／次序如何进入实际使用，分别观察当前依赖与旧内容认可。
next_delta.en: Building on the preserved conditional connections, identify how formed access and retained source/order information guide actual use in a matched developmental procedure, distinguishing present reliance from old-content endorsement.

history.zh: 2026-10-08：从原始汇总与纳入名单直接复算后续目标注视，保留不确定性、纳入差异及正面比较，接入已有研究与完整目标。
history.en: 2026-10-08: directly reconstructed later target looking from original summaries and the inclusion log, preserving uncertainty, inclusion differences and a positive comparison; integrated with the existing study and full objective.

history.zh: 2026-10-09：已读研究21–23节；取得的来源关系现以另一路径生成旧命名记录的绑定候选。原声明、证明、经验结果与反例不改写；历史适用范围的新反例具体化后续连接。
history.en: 2026-10-09: reviewed study sections 21–23. Acquired source relations now generate binding alternatives for old naming records through an additional route. Original claims, proofs, empirical results and failures remain; a historical-applicability counterexample sharpens the next connection.

history.zh: 2026-10-09：核读同一研究新增历史适用范围组合与反审；本项既有主张、源码及实查不变，接续问题转向来源—时序保持和持续性假设的经验识别。
history.en: 2026-10-09: reviewed the same study’s historical-applicability composition and counterreview. This result’s prior claim, sources and scientific checks remain unchanged; the continuation now targets empirical identification of source–time retention and persistence assumptions.

No claim, premise, status, dependency, reference or source hash changed. Every earlier sentence is mapped in the [migration table](../../../../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/history/root-foundation/development/becoming-general-laws-plan/readability/migrations/encounter-control-and-retention.md); the exact earlier record is text_versions[0].
